decisions.2: No push access to SovereignWebsite__IaC for strategy.b, grace.b or strategy.d. Agents publish their keys in their own repositories; only the IaC pipelines connect to the IaC repository.
decisions.5: Yes, confirmed: mistral.conductor keeps its signing key in a file only it can read.
decisions.8: No: feedback.b is not told to act on decisions.b's signed records. All feedback is driven by QR codes (the sealed, QR-connected lanes).
decisions.31: The first handed-over site may be listed on our website, without naming its owner for now. No marketing beyond the listing.
